title: Feature grid
description: Card grid for factor, process, included, fit and small-card sections. Styles: rule (top-ruled columns), numbered (01–04 cards, last one dark), icon (icon cards), checks (fit checklist in one card), tiles (compact title + text cards).

techdella.help: Items: [{title, text, icon, url, tone}]. icon: list, lines, nodes, chart, person, chat, search, target, check. tone (icon style): paper, canvas, sand, dark. highlight: index of the one accented item (-1 = last for rule/numbered, none otherwise; -2 = none). checks: title + lead render inside one card; item title is bold, text follows. bare: no section/container (to sit inside columns next to a testimonial or pricing card).
